newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree in credit card venture.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree in credit card venture.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Monday its Green Tree Retail Services division reached agreement with Hardware Wholesalers Inc to provide a new private brand credit card, Do It Best card, for use by HWI's 3,400-plus retail-members.
The new program will be introduced to HWI members at a trade show in October in Indianapolis on October 17-22.
Green Tree said it has plans to offer immediately a number of new credit programs to help HWI retailers stimulate additional sales volume.

Based in Fort Wayne, Ind., HWI is a member-owned hardware and building material buying cooperative operating throughout the United States and 27 other countries. Founded in 1945, HWI membership is comprised of hardware, home center and building material retail-members with both single and multiple store locations.

Launched in 1995, Green Tree Retail Services provides revolving credit for merchants and their customers. Green Tree Financial is a national diversified financial services company with a loan portfolio of $16.3 billion at June 3O, l996.
